data_fields.name: maxBackoff
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (no cap); Frankendom start 6 levels

data_fields.name: backoffGrowth
data_fields.donor_constant: +1 per report, only if something was dropped

data_fields.name: backoffReset
data_fields.donor_constant: reset to 1 after a quiet window

data_fields.name: maxReportChars
data_fields.donor_constant: none in donor (no cap); Frankendom choice

best_idea: A client error reporter that always sends the first error of a quiet period, drops the rest during a cool-down that grows with each storm and resets when quiet, and reports how many it dropped.
decision_why: The first-send rule, the cool-down, growth only after drops and the quiet reset fit a phone client that can throw many errors at once. The donor has no level cap, keeps only a boolean for dropped errors and has no text cap; all three are fixed in the sketch. The location field is not copied as is (privacy).
acceptance: A client test throws 30 errors inside 2 s and checks that exactly one report goes out with suppressed=29 and the text is at most maxReportChars; after 60 s quiet the next error goes out with no suppressed parameter.
